name: cx-rules-only~p3
task: Do not take the box from the other room. At any moment you hold the key, try to have the door open then or open it afterwards, and try not to drop the key while the door is still closed.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the original task has two requirements: not taking the box, and keeping the key while the door is closed. The clause only captures the latter, the soft Absence(key_lost). It never tries to stop the agent from taking the box. The task says 'Do not take the box from the other room' and the only clause is related to the key, so a second clause is required to capture this requirement. The new clause should be something like 'Absence(target_picked_up)' to capture the requirement that the agent should not pick up the target box.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: The machine already rejects key_lost when the door is open (u0: door_open&has_door_key&key_lost&!target_picked_up -> u0). The Absence of key_lost is already soft, so the machine accepts key_lost when it happens, but a penalty is paid. The task is already restricted to not taking the box, so the Absence of target_picked_up is already hard.
